sloka: साधनानि मुनिश्रेष्ठ ततो अहम् भृश दुःखितः ।ततो देव गणान् सर्वान् तपसा अहम् प्रसादयम् ॥१-६६-२३॥
transliteration: sādhanāni muniśreṣṭha tato aham bhṛśa duḥkhitaḥ ।tato deva gaṇān sarvān tapasā aham prasādayam ॥1-66-23॥

translations.english: Thereafter, I propitiated the gods by my austerities. Highly pleased, they gave me an army of four divisions (chariots, elephants, horses and infantry ).
translations.hindi: ऋहषिपुत्र का वचन सुन, राजा परमहर्षित हो तुरन्त अपनी यज्ञशाला को गया
